key_warnings_mentioned: Silent CDN referrer protection — 32-byte 'Access denied' with HTTP 200 looks like success but produces broken files
JS base URL variable trap — asset URLs constructed at runtime from minified variable, not hardcoded in HTML
Never run broad regex on style blocks — silently destroys minified CSS
Always use absolute paths — relative paths break on subdirectory pages
CSS source order — injected <style> at top of <head> loses to later <link> stylesheets
